definitions.explanation: The top leader or representative of an organization, association, club, or committee. Distinct from 社長, which refers specifically to the president of a company.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{会長|かいちょう}が{選|えら}ばれた。
{会長|かいちょう}が{開会|かいかい}の{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: The chairman gave the opening address.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はPTAの{会長|かいちょう}を{三年間|さんねんかん}{務|つと}めた。
examples.english: She served as PTA president for three years.

notes:
Used for the head of associations, clubs, committees, and similar organizations — not for commercial companies, where {社長|しゃちょう} is used instead. In large corporate groups, {会長|かいちょう} may refer to the chairman of the board, a position above {社長|しゃちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{会長|かいちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する — to assume the chairmanship
・{会長|かいちょう}を{務|つと}める — to serve as chairman
・{副|ふく}{会長|かいちょう} — vice president
・{名誉|めいよ}{会長|かいちょう} — honorary chairman
